name: Danish Fewest Moves Championship 2026
information: Dette er danmarksmesterskabet i 3x3 i Færrest Træk og afholder kun denne disciplin, som ikke er specielt egnet for nye deltagere. Der er flere lokaler man kan vælge at deltage i. Lokaler kan ses [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DanishFMChampionship2026#75526-lokaler-locations). ------ This is the Danish championship in 3x3 Fewest moves and will only host this event which not very suitable for new competitors. There are multiple venues you can compete at. Locations can be seen [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DanishFMChampionship2026#75526-lokaler-locations).
